pattern.name: Film gate and cue marks
pattern.description: Open film-gate registration brackets, a narrow perforation rhythm and offset editing-cue lines on pale sage paper. Green belongs to this independent presentation, while the clapperboard stays black and ivory.

framing.note: The complete board, raised stick and hinge share one uniform placement. Require at least 128 px clearance against the actual rounded outline without cropping or changing the native drawing.

matte.calibrationNote: Modal native outer-eight-pixel matte is (251,252,252). Use only exterior-connected extraction; ivory stripes, printed lettering and metal highlights are opaque surfaces protected by the board's dark contour. Inspect all pale surfaces and the open gap between the sticks; do not globally delete white or remove unreviewed components. Inspected all 31 disconnected residue regions (215 native pixels, minimum RGB channel 241) on a native crop contact sheet. They are near-white exterior noise and fringe, not opaque lettering or physical details. The 64-pixel component threshold removes only these regions; the complete 2,164,172-pixel object remains connected.
